UNION ALL SELECT MR.request_key, MR.cret_dt, '1' AS form_type_cd, MR.req_buy_type_cd AS req_buy_type_cd, MR.oper_type_cd AS oper_type_cd, MR.proc_cd, MRC.cstmr_nm, MRC.cstmr_native_birth, MR.cstmr_type_cd, MR.identity_cert_type_cd AS identity_cert_type_cd, MR.agent_cd, MR.agent_nm, MR.shop_cd, MR.shop_nm, MR.cret_id, MR.scan_id AS requestScanId, (select user_nm from msf_user_info where user_id = MR.cret_id) as cret_nm FROM MSF_REQUEST MR LEFT JOIN MSF_REQUEST_CSTMR MRC ON MR.request_key = MRC.request_key
AND coalesce(MR.volume_rep_mobile_no,'') = ''

UNION ALL SELECT MR.request_key, MR.cret_dt, '2' AS form_type_cd, NULL AS req_buy_type_cd, NULL AS oper_type_cd, MR.proc_cd, MRC.cstmr_nm, MRC.cstmr_native_birth, MR.cstmr_type_cd, NULL AS identity_cert_type_cd, MR.agent_cd, MR.agent_nm, MR.shop_cd, MR.shop_nm, MR.cret_id,
d.dtl_scan_ids AS requestScanId, (select user_nm from msf_user_info where user_id = MR.cret_id) as cret_nm FROM MSF_REQUEST_SVC_CHG MR LEFT JOIN ( SELECT request_key, STRING_AGG(scan_id, ', ' ORDER BY scan_id) AS dtl_scan_ids FROM smartform.msf_request_svc_chg_dtl WHERE scan_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY request_key ) d ON MR.request_key = d.request_key LEFT JOIN MSF_REQUEST_CSTMR MRC ON MR.request_key = MRC.request_key

UNION ALL SELECT MR.request_key, MR.cret_dt, '3' AS form_type_cd, NULL AS req_buy_type_cd, NULL AS oper_type_cd, MR.proc_cd, MRC.cstmr_nm, MRC.cstmr_native_birth, MR.cstmr_type_cd, NULL AS identity_cert_type_cd, MR.agent_cd, MR.agent_nm, MR.shop_cd, MR.shop_nm, MR.cret_id, MR.scan_id AS requestScanId, (select user_nm from msf_user_info where user_id = MR.cret_id) as cret_nm FROM MSF_REQUEST_NAME_CHG MR LEFT JOIN MSF_REQUEST_CSTMR MRC ON MR.request_key = MRC.request_key

UNION ALL SELECT MR.request_key, MR.cret_dt, '4' AS form_type_cd, NULL AS req_buy_type_cd, NULL AS oper_type_cd, MR.proc_cd, MRC.cstmr_nm, MRC.cstmr_native_birth, MR.cstmr_type_cd, NULL AS identity_cert_type_cd, MR.agent_cd, MR.agent_nm, MR.shop_cd, MR.shop_nm, MR.cret_id, MR.scan_id AS requestScanId, (select user_nm from msf_user_info where user_id = MR.cret_id) as cret_nm FROM MSF_REQUEST_CANCEL MR LEFT JOIN MSF_REQUEST_CSTMR MRC ON MR.request_key = MRC.request_key
